records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $366.2 million, an increase of 14.5% from the $319.8 million in the three months ended June 30, 2024 and an increase of 10.3% from the $332.1 in three months ended March 31, 2025;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increasing demand in the three months ended June 30, 2025 also contributed to channel inventory being reduced further and with both channel and internal inventory days decreasing.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Channel inventory depletion continues to limit increased loading at our manufacturing facilities, resulting in under loading costs creating difficulty in gross margin expansion.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit margin was 31.5%, compared to 33.6% in the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 31.5% in the three months ended March 31, 2025;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flow provided by operations was $41.5 million.
